name: Chris Northfield
original_name: クリス・ノースフィールド
source:
A mysterious boy who appears in Arata's class as an exchange student, Chris is the prince of the fantasy kingdom of Seven Central and the heir to the throne.
[spoiler]Chris is really a girl who dresses up as a boy.[/spoiler]
